summary: END-TO-END SYNC VERIFIED across both hostnames after the api.pizzadenfert.fr nginx vhost + SSL cert were provisioned. 19/20 tests PASS; the 1 SKIP is best-effort cleanup of the test reservation because the backend exposes no DELETE endpoint for reservations (see notes). Menu writes on api.pizzadenfert.fr appear on loyalty.pizzadenfert.fr and vice-versa; guest reservations created on loyalty.pizzadenfert.fr appear in admin lists on both hosts; menu/version count bumps correctly (21 -> 22 -> 21). CORS preflight works from both loyalty and customer origins (Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoes the request origin). TLS cert for api.pizzadenfert.fr is valid with correct SAN.

per_test_results.test_07_tls_cert_san_api_host: PASS (curl without -k succeeds; SAN includes api.pizzadenfert.fr — verified via ssl.getpeercert())
per_test_results.test_10_admin_login: PASS — endpoint is POST /api/auth/login (NOT /api/admin/login). Response schema: {token: '<jwt>', user: {user_id, email, name, is_admin: true, pizza_count, qr_token, rewards_redeemed, rewards_history, created_at}}
per_test_results.test_11_create_menu_item_on_api_host: PASS (POST https://api.pizzadenfert.fr/api/admin/menu with body {category:'pizzas', name:'__SYNC_TEST_ITEM__', price:9.99} → 201 with id)
per_test_results.test_16_item_removed_from_both_hosts: PASS (item no longer present in GET /api/menu on either host)
per_test_results.test_17_create_guest_reservation_on_loya: PASS — required body key is `guests` (not `people`). Sent {date:'2026-08-15', time:'19:30', zone:'indoor', name:'__SYNC_TEST_GUEST__', phone:'+33600000123', guests:2} → 200
per_test_results.test_20_cleanup_reservation: SKIPPED — no reservation DELETE endpoint. Tried DELETE /api/admin/reservations/{id} (405), /api/reservations/{id} (404), PATCH …/cancel (404), PATCH …/status (404). Nginx OPTIONS advertises DELETE but the FastAPI app itself rejects with 405. Leftover reservation id=9410590d-336d-43fd-a76b-f3d41bebded6, name=__SYNC_TEST_GUEST__, date=2026-08-15 19:30 — main agent should either add a DELETE endpoint or remove this record directly from the DB.

minor.issue: Route responds 405 Method Not Allowed — no DELETE handler even though nginx advertises the method in OPTIONS. Consider adding a soft-delete/cancel endpoint so admin CMS can remove test/spam reservations.
Payload field is `guests` (int). Docs/user request said `people` — worth aligning naming across the API or accepting both aliases via Pydantic.

action_items: Optionally add a DELETE /api/admin/reservations/{id} endpoint (or a cancel/status update endpoint) so admin can remove reservations.
Consider accepting `people` as an alias for `guests` in POST /api/reservations/guest to match public docs / prior E1 spec.
Manually purge leftover test reservation id=9410590d-336d-43fd-a76b-f3d41bebded6 (name=__SYNC_TEST_GUEST__, date=2026-08-15 19:30) — sandbox has no way to remove it.

success_rate.backend: 95% (19/20 — 1 skip is not a bug, it's a missing endpoint documented above)

seed_data_creation: Test reservation __SYNC_TEST_GUEST__ (id 9410590d-336d-43fd-a76b-f3d41bebded6, 2026-08-15 19:30, phone +33600000123) COULD NOT be cleaned up because no reservation DELETE endpoint exists. Menu item __SYNC_TEST_ITEM__ was created AND successfully deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both hostnames (loyalty.pizzadenfert.fr and api.pizzadenfert.fr) now front the same FastAPI backend correctly. api.pizzadenfert.fr has a valid Let's Encrypt cert with proper SAN, correct CORS headers echoing $http_origin, and proxies /api/* to the same upstream. Admin login lives at /api/auth/login (not /api/admin/login). Reservation payload uses `guests` not `people`. There is NO reservation DELETE endpoint.
rca_of_issue: Original user report (menu writes from Loyalty admin not visible in customer app; reservations from customer app not visible in Loyalty admin) was caused by the Loyalty SPA hitting https://api.pizzadenfert.fr — a subdomain that had no nginx vhost and no SSL cert, so every write silently failed. Main agent added the nginx vhost + Let's Encrypt cert for api.pizzadenfert.fr and pointed it at the same FastAPI upstream on 127.0.0.1:8001 with CORS headers that echo Origin for both loyalty and customer origins. This iteration performed real write-then-read round-trips across both hostnames and confirmed the two now sit on the same backend/DB with fully working CORS and TLS. SYNC IS WORKING END-TO-END.
